summary.text:
Let me analyze each visual item carefully.

V01: Home page with common navigation.
Reference: Top black bar with US | English, Shop new arrivals, Enter ZIP code, Select store. White header with IKEA logo, Products, Rooms, Deals, Design & ideas, Services, search "What are you looking for?", Hej! Log in or sign up, heart, bag. Category chips row: Deals (tag icon), Winter holiday shop (tree), Storage & organization, Sofas & armchairs, Beds & mattresses, Lighting, Kitchen... Main hero: large left image (IKEA Family price drawer), right side has top-right large image (New kitchen accessories) with pause button overlay in reference, bottom row smaller images.

Candidate: Very similar. Black bar same. Header same. Category chips: Deals but with tree icon (reference has tag icon for Deals and tree for Winter holiday), slight icon mapping differences but layout same. Main hero similar images (same kitchen drawer and kitchen accessories). Cookie banner present at bottom in candidate (reference doesn't show in V01 but that's an overlay; reference V02 shows cookie banner too actually). The pause button on video absent in candidate (reference has pause overlay at center). Dynamic promo video content differences exempted. Overall structure, proportions, images, hierarchy match very closely. Minor: chip icons slightly different (Deals has tree in candidate vs tag in reference; Winter holiday has tree in reference vs box in candidate). These are small local differences. Cookie banner overlay in candidate not in ref V01, but it's a transient overlay; still it occupies bottom. I'd score 0.75 or 1. The main structure matches strongly. The category chip icon differences are minor. Cookie banner is an overlay that appears in candidate V01 but reference V01 doesn't have it (though reference V02 has it). This could be considered a local difference. Given close match, I'd lean 0.75 due to chip icon swaps and cookie banner/pause overlay differences. Actually the pause button is part of dynamic video exemption. Cookie banner appears in reference for V02/V03? Reference V02 and V03? V03 reference doesn't show cookie banner. Candidate V01 shows cookie banner; reference V01 doesn't. It's a small overlay at bottom. I'll give 0.75 — key layout correct, only minor local differences (chip icons, cookie banner, pause overlay). Could argue 1 but there are noticeable chip icon differences. 0.75 seems fair.

V02: Mega menu.
Reference: Products underlined active. Pill tabs row: New & trending (active outlined blue), Winter holiday shop, Storage & organization, Sofas & armchairs, Beds & mattresses, Lighting, Kitchen appliances & suppl> (truncated with arrow). Below: left column Explore all new, Limited collections, Home accessories shop, IKEA for Business. Columns: Trending (New products, Best sellers, Gift guide, IKEA Live Shopping), Seasonal (Fall decor shop, Halloween decor, Thanksgiving essentials, Explore all shops), Food (IKEA Swedish Restaurant & Bistro, IKEA Swedish Food Market, Food recipes). Right: orange promo card "Game on with YXSTABY...". Background dimmed page below.

Candidate: Similar pill tabs but "Kitchen, appliances & supplies" full text no arrow truncation (minor). Left column same 4 links. Columns: Trending same, Seasonal same, but Food column missing — instead candidate has promo image (dining room photo) above orange card on right; reference has Food column text and no photo (orange card lower). So candidate replaced the Food column area with an image and shifted orange card. That's a notable structural difference in right portion: reference has 3 text columns (Trending/Seasonal/Food) + orange card bottom-right; candidate has 2 text columns + image top-right + orange card below. Missing Food column = one important part. Category density differs. I'd score 0.5 (recognizable same page/state but multiple obvious differences / one important section missing - Food column). Could be 0.75 if we consider right-side promo acceptable, but missing entire Food column is important. 0.5.

Actually re-evaluate: criteria "宽幅菜单分栏、类别密度、活动项和下方背景" (wide menu columns, category density, active item and background below). Candidate missing Food column and has extra image; column count differs (3 vs 2 text columns). That's a clear structural difference. 0.5 seems right.

V03: Search + white filter.
Reference: search "besta", help banner, "87 items for besta", Design your own BESTÅ storage card top-right, left filter with Sort/Size/Color expanded showing color swatches (Gray, White selected check, Black, Beige, Brown, Green) with counts, active filter chip "white ×" near top, product grid 4 columns with Compare checkboxes, IKEA Family price labels, prices, blue bag buttons, Best seller tag on 3rd item, scrollbar on left filter.

Candidate: search besta, banner, 87 items, design card, left filter collapsed list (Sort, Size, Color collapsed, Type, Category, Smart home 5, Material, Doors, Features, Price, Finish) — Color not expanded so no swatches visible; white chip + Clear all present; product grid 4 columns, Compare, prices similar, Best seller on 4th instead of 3rd, products differ (3rd is oak effect not white, 4th shelving unit $136 vs TV bench $184). The key difference: reference has Color filter expanded with swatches and white selected shown via check; candidate has filters collapsed (just shows white chip). Product assortment differs somewhat (dynamic catalog maybe). Layout: left sidebar, grid, chip, hierarchy match. But expanded color swatch panel (an important visual element in reference) is collapsed/absent in candidate — that's a notable state difference. However the criteria is "搜索与白色筛选" left filter, grid, active filter, price/promo hierarchy. Candidate shows white filter chip active and Clear all, left filter present but collapsed (different expansion state). Product grid and price hierarchy match. The collapsed vs expanded color swatches is one important local difference but overall same state (white filtered results). I'd give 0.75 (key layout correct, active white filter shown, minor differences: filter panel collapsed vs expanded swatches, product order/Best seller position differ). Actually expanded color swatches is fairly prominent. But since the state is "white filter applied" and candidate shows that via chip, and sidebar exists, 0.75 is appropriate. Product differences may be dynamic inventory; not heavily penalize. 0.75.

V04: Compare page.
Reference: Product comparison title, two columns with X remove buttons, product images, heart buttons, IKEA Family price, BESTÅ titles, prices $55/$76, 15% off save, regular price, price valid, star ratings (1550)/(4773), Key features section starting with Width rows.

Candidate: Very close. Title, two columns, X buttons, images same products, hearts (positioned above the family price rather than overlapped on image bottom-right — in reference hearts overlap bottom-right of image; candidate hearts are to the right above label? Let me look: reference heart circles are at bottom-right corner of each product image overlapping; candidate hearts appear at right side just above IKEA Family price line, near add-to-bag. Actually candidate heart is at top-right of the info area next to title, bag button below it. Reference heart on image bottom-right, bag button to right of price. Slight icon placement differences. Overall columns, images, prices, attributes, Key features all match. Candidate has "More options" links under ratings (reference may have below fold). Minor spacing: candidate columns slightly wider apart? Very close. I'd score 1 or 0.75. The structure, proportions, images, attribute table match strongly. Minor: heart/bag icon vertical arrangement differs slightly, candidate shows More options link, reference Key features Width visible at bottom (candidate Key features header visible but Width rows below fold not shown). Since viewport cut differs slightly. These are minor. I'd give 1 — main structure, proportions, images, hierarchy, styles match. But to be conservative about icon placement and More options extra, 0.75? The criteria: 对比列宽、商品图、价格、属性表与分隔. All match. The differences are very small. I'll give 1. Hmm, candidate heart icon placement: in reference heart is overlaid on image bottom-right; in candidate heart is beside the title area. Looking again at candidate: heart outline is to the right, at level just above "IKEA Family price"? It appears at right edge around title height, and blue bag below it. In reference, heart is on image bottom-right, bag is to right of price text. So the action icon placement differs (heart moved from image to info column). That's a local difference. Still key layout correct → 0.75 might be safer. But it's fairly minor within an otherwise near-identical page. I'll settle 0.75 for V04? 

Let me decide consistently: V01 0.75, V02 0.5, V03 0.75, V04 0.75 or 1. 

For V04, the match is genuinely high: same two products, same prices, same ratings, same layout of two columns, Key features. The heart position difference is small. I'll give V04 = 1 since main structure/proportion/image/hierarchy/style all吻合 and differences are trivial local icon placement. Actually the rule 1 = 主要结构、比例、图片、层级和样式吻合. That fits. Minor icon relocation doesn't break main structure. Give 1.

For V01, main structure matches; differences: chip icons swapped/mismatched (Deals icon), cookie banner overlay present, pause overlay absent. These are local; main structure吻合. Could be 1 too. But category chip row icons are noticeably different (Deals shows tree instead of tag; Winter holiday shows cabinet instead of tree; etc. — icons shifted). That's a series of local icon differences across the chip row, more than trivial. And cookie banner covers bottom. 0.75 is fair for V01.

Final: V01 0.75, V02 0.5, V03 0.75, V04 1.

Need JSON only, no totals. Evidence ids reference file and candidate file.
